transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I suppose I'm just... having some trouble settling down. I feel like I'm always up and moving around. Even on a quiet day, I just sort of... bounce from one thing to another. Like, I'll look at my garden club list, then I'm over by my knitting bag, and then I'm sorting through some travel papers... before I've really finished any one thing. It's just a bit tiring, I guess.
Have there been times when you felt unusually cheerful or high?
No... I wouldn't say that. I just feel... normal, I suppose. Not unusually anything.
Did you have these kinds of trouble focusing and jumping from one task to another when you were a child?

Well... I suppose so. It's been a long time, but... back in grade school, my teachers used to tell my mother I was bright, but... scattered. I guess I was always losing my school papers. And... talking out of turn. They said I was always wiggling in my seat before I actually finished my work. So... yes, I suppose.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying?
No... not really. Just the usual things, I suppose. I don't think I worry any more than anyone else does.
